title: Divan Storage Base with Drawers – Upholstered Divan Bed
descriptionHtml:
The Divan Storage Base with Drawers is an upholstered divan bed base with built-in drawers, handmade to order in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire. The drawers pull straight out, so you get organised under-bed storage with no lifting, and the firm platform top supports your mattress. From £168.99 in Single 3ft to £259.99 in Super King 6ft, with free delivery across Great Britain.

Key features

  • Built-in storage drawers for easy access
  • Firm platform top base
  • Quality upholstered fabric finish
  • Handmade to order in our Dewsbury workshop, West Yorkshire
  • Free fabric swatches available

Sizes

Available in the sizes below, with prices from the current listing. Not sure which size to choose? See our UK bed sizes guide or email us.

  • Single 3ft: £168.99
  • Small Double 4ft: £188.99
  • Double 4ft6: £194.99
  • King 5ft: £214.99
  • Super King 6ft: £259.99

Materials & build

Built on a solid wood frame and upholstered by hand in our own workshop. Choose from Plush Velvet, Chenille, Coniston, Naples, Galaxy and Teddy Bouclé fabrics in solid colours, stripes or two-tone; custom fabric and colour options are available on request, and free swatches let you check at home.

Storage

The built-in drawers pull out for easy, organised access to bedding, clothes and spare linen without lifting the mattress. Leave clear floor in front of the drawers so they can open fully. If you prefer a lift-up base, see our divan ottoman beds.

Mattress compatibility

The firm platform top supports any mattress in the matching size. Add our Memory Orthopaedic Mattress from £142.99 or 3000 Pocket Sprung Mattress from £220.99 to complete the bed.

Customisation

Choose solid colours, stripes or two-tone fabrics, or ask about a custom fabric and colour. It pairs with any Eagle Bed headboard, so you can pick the headboard separately from our headboards.

Delivery, returns & warranty

Every Eagle Bed is made to order in our Pepproyd Street workshop in Dewsbury. Delivery is free across Great Britain (England, Scotland and Wales) by our own team, usually within 3–5 working days. Delivery to Northern Ireland is £90.

Changed your mind? You have 14 days for free returns (we collect it free) as long as the item is unused, unassembled and in its original packaging. If anything arrives faulty we will arrange a free replacement or a full refund. Every bed also carries a 5-year warranty, and you can spread the cost with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout.

More storage: browse divan beds and storage beds with drawers. Not sure whether a divan or a frame suits you? Read divan bed vs bed frame.

FAQ

How do the drawers work?

They pull straight out, so there is no lifting. Leave clear floor in front of the drawers so they can open fully.

Does it come with a headboard?

No, it is a divan base. It pairs with any Eagle Bed headboard, which you choose separately.

What sizes and prices are available?

Single 3ft £168.99, Small Double 4ft £188.99, Double 4ft6 £194.99, King 5ft £214.99, Super King 6ft £259.99.

Can I see the fabric before I buy?

Yes. Free fabric swatches are available, so you can check colour and feel at home. Choose solid colours, stripes or two-tone, or ask about a custom fabric and colour.

What is your returns policy?

You have 14 days for free returns, with free collection, if the item is unused, unassembled and in its original packaging. Faulty items get a free replacement or a full refund.

Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon–Fri 9am–6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

Not sure on colour? Order free fabric swatches and see the fabric at home before you buy.
